title: Casualty Claims Desk — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Unit Released After a Total Loss
content:
**Rule.** When a unit pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan has been destroyed and the member's insurer has settled the loss, the loss is registered as a submitted collateral release request naming the unit's serial number and the settlement amount, and the unit is released with the release reason total loss while the loan is in active status; the release price is applied to principal as release proceeds on the release date and is never more than the principal balance, and a unit already released is never released again.

## What the records show after the release

| Record | Shows |
|---|---|
| Collateral record of the loan | a release of the destroyed unit, with the release reason total loss, pointing to that unit's pledge record |
| Transaction history | a principal payment of the release proceeds, pointing to that release |
| Loan record | the principal balance and the pledged value still securing the loan, both lowered |

## Situations side by side

| Situation | Release after total loss |
|---|---|
| Loan in active status, request submitted naming the unit, unit not yet released | released with the release reason total loss |
| Loan not in active status | not released |
| Unit already released | never released again |

## The release tool: `release_total_loss_unit_e8bdf554`

**Capability.** With this tool the member signs the release of their own pledged unit destroyed in a total loss and assigns the settlement: the member, as owner of the destroyed unit, signs its release from the loan and assigns the insurance settlement (with any difference the member pays) to the association. The association's lien on that one unit is released today with the release reason total loss, the release amount given is applied to the loan's principal as release proceeds, and the loan's principal balance and the pledged value securing it fall accordingly. Afterwards the unit shows as released in the loan's collateral record and the release proceeds show in its transaction history.

**How it is invoked.** It is the member's own act: the servicing representative unlocks `release_total_loss_unit_e8bdf554` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member who owns the unit and holds the loan, as read to the member from the member profile lookup | identifier |
| `loan_id` | the loan number of the equipment loan the destroyed unit secures, as read to the member from the equipment loan lookup | identifier |
| `source_action_id` | the reference number of the pledge record of the destroyed unit, as read to the member from the equipment collateral lookup | identifier |
| `release_proceeds` | the release amount applied to principal for the destroyed unit, as told to the member by the servicing representative | USD, 2 decimal places, always positive; stored at 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A receipt with `release_action_id` (reference number of the new release record), `payment_txn_id` (reference number of the release-proceeds principal payment), `loan_id`, `serial_number` (the released unit's serial number), `release_proceeds` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount applied), `principal_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, principal after the release), `collateral_value` (USD, 2 decimal places, pledged value still securing the loan) and `action_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today). The presence of `release_action_id` indicates the release took effect.
